name: Concept Hierarchy
description: Concept-level stage gating (vowel types, match complexity, consonant categories)

name: GPC Hierarchy
description: Three-stage GPC gating chain (expose→intro→exercise) with digraph and GPC-specific prerequisites

name: UI Hierarchy
description: UI type progression gating (word-selection → missing-letters → spelling)

name: GPC Interference Mitigation
description: Visual and phonetic confusion pair separation (b/d, p/q, voicing pairs, etc.)

name: Intro Gate Filter
description: Entitlement boundary: once an unpaid account can decode the free-tier word ceiling, intros for graphemes the child has not yet met are withheld. Cards for already-introduced graphemes are never touched — the wall stops new supply, it does not repossess.

name: Lesson Gate Filter
description: Gates concept cards behind lesson completion/dismissal — prevents concept content from appearing before the lesson is handled

name: Letter Gating Filter
description: Spelling (SpellingQuestion) is categorically prohibited until all 26 keycaps are unlocked. MissingLetters is gated at the target-word level (all letters in the word must be unlocked). WordSelection is not gated.

name: Prescribed Intro Backpressure
description: Progressive prescribed intro surfacing with minimal support cards for blocked expose-prerequisite chains

name: GPC Priority Ordering
description: Tag weights derived from teaching sequence order and letter frequency

name: Recent Weakness Boost
description: Boosts cards for skills missed lately: up to ×2 on the card's weakest gpc:exercise tag, from misses in its last 12 presentations, relieved by later presentations and a 3-day half-life. Replaces the session failure boost (difficultyBooster).

name: Skill Pressure
description: Leans selection toward weak letter-sounds: up to ×1.5 on a card's most pressured gpc:exercise tag. Pressure is the larger of need (rating below the median of the learner's skills) and insecurity (shaky 0.8, unproven 0.5).

name: Skill Staleness Boost
description: Boosts cards for practiced skills that haven't had a first attempt lately: ×(1 + days/7) on the card's stalest gpc:exercise tag, uncapped. Practicing the skill resets it, so the boost closes itself.
